newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P says TNT still on positive watch.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P says TNT still on positive watch.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said its B-plus long term rating for Australian transport group TNT Ltd remains on positive watch after TNT and Air New Zealand Ltd came to an agreement for Air NZ to buy TNT's 50 percent stake in airline Ansett Australia.
TNT was placed on positive watch in November 1995.
Air NZ agreed to buy TNT's stake in Ansett for a total investment of A$450 million.

"Standard and Poor's resolution of the TNT CreditWatch placement will be determined when the financial plans related to this transaction become defined more clearly and the company's future business risk profile can be assessed better," S&P said.
S&P said TNT was gradually rebuilding its balance sheet, although this had been difficult and slow to implement.

"While the divestiture of Ansett and subsequent debt reduction would lower gearing, it could be some time before any substantial improvement in the company's earnings capability becomes clearly apparent," S&P said.
